title: Normalize work-item and task list option syntax
objective: Update the sdlc work-item and task listing commands to use the explicit --work-item <work-item> option form consistently.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation and commit of the next work item on the current repository.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/*

update sdlc work-item to use --work-item <work-item> and update sdlc task list <work-item> to use sdlc task list --work-item <work-item>

Commit the work item.

scope.name: work-item-option-syntax
scope.description: Change sdlc work-item list to accept and document --work-item <work-item> as its explicit selection option.
scope.reason: The work-item command should use the same named-option convention as other work-item-aware CLI commands.

scope.name: task-option-syntax
scope.description: Change sdlc task list to accept and document --work-item <work-item> instead of a positional work-item argument.
scope.reason: Consistent named options make command invocation and future option extension unambiguous.

nonGoals.name: discovery-semantics
nonGoals.description: Do not change work-item/task discovery ordering, output schemas, filesystem boundaries, or read-only behavior beyond the argument contract.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0003 is limited to option syntax normalization.

nonGoals.name: execution-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not execute or mutate discovered tasks, add provider/runtime behavior, deploy, publish, or approve a release.
nonGoals.reason: This is a CLI contract change only.

items.name: work-item-option-contract
items.description: sdlc work-item list must use --work-item <work-item> as its explicit work-item option form and report missing or invalid values clearly.
items.reason: The command contract must be explicit and consistent with named-option CLI conventions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The command help documents sdlc work-item list --work-item <work-item>, and a valid option invocation returns the selected work item without modifying records.
Missing, duplicate, or unknown --work-item values return stable non-zero errors.

items.name: task-option-contract
items.description: sdlc task list must use --work-item <work-item> as its explicit selection option and report missing or invalid values clearly.
items.reason: Task listing should have one consistent named-option interface for selecting a work item.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The command help documents sdlc task list --work-item <work-item>, and a valid option invocation lists the selected task records in the existing deterministic order.
Missing, duplicate, or unknown --work-item values return stable non-zero errors without changing task files.

items.name: option-regression-coverage
items.description: Focused tests must cover both command option parsers, valid selection, invalid selection, and unchanged discovery output.
items.reason: Argument syntax changes can silently break existing command routing and must preserve discovery semantics.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn test passes with coverage for both --work-item command routes and their stable error paths.
